key_points: JPMorgan downgraded PEP with a 19% price target cut, flagging persistent Frito-Lay/North America snack weakness
Dividend increased 4% to 4.6% forward yield, but headlines note profits fell sharply and question cash flow sustainability
North America demand softness continues; international snacks/beverages providing offset
Stock down ~14% from highs; some valuation analyses call it undervalued
Q3 earnings due next month with only marginal EPS improvement expected
